validation_scope: Archived workload logs, CPU/RAM samples and recorded durability/exit assertions; not a fresh database, binary or trace audit.
limitations: Fixed-rate batches per trader; batch size3; completed trades counted from ledger.
Separate warmup ceremony; measured setup excluded using upstream mode transitions.
CPU counters bracket logged boundaries with at most250ms extra at each edge.
Latency is Ledger command/batch latency for DvP, health.ping call latency for ping.
Unavailable CPU/RAM metrics are null; synchronizer-only DvP resource metrics exclude participants and PostgreSQL.
Instrumented timings are diagnostic; individual commands are not independent benchmark repetitions.

scala_baseline.scope: Scala participants and Scala synchronizer with matching comparison configuration. Single observations; descriptive differences only.
